nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold modeled on a real normed space, and let $g$ be a $C^\infty$ Riemannian metric on $M$, with inner product $g_x$ on the tangent space $T_x M$. The conformal class of $g$ is the set of $C^\infty$ Riemannian metrics $g'$ on $M$ for which there is a $C^\infty$ function $u : M \to \mathbb{R}$ with $u(x) > 0$ for all $x \in M$ and $g'_x(v, w) = u(x)\, g_x(v, w)$ for all $x \in M$ and all…
nodes.title: Conformal class of a Riemannian metric

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real vector bundle over a manifold $B$, let $n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty, \omega\}$, let $g$ be a $C^n$ Riemannian metric on $E$, with inner product $g_b$ on the fiber $E_b$, and let $u : B \to \mathbb{R}$ be a $C^n$ function with $u(b) > 0$ for every $b \in B$. Then the conformal scaling $u g$ of $g$ by $u$ satisfies $(u g)_b(v, w) = u(b)\, g_b(v, w)$ for every $b \in B$ and all $v, w \in E_b$.
nodes.title: Inner product of a conformally scaled metric

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold modeled on a real normed space, let $g$ be a $C^\infty$ Riemannian metric on $M$, and let $u : M \to \mathbb{R}$ be a $C^\infty$ function with $u(x) > 0$ for all $x \in M$. Then the conformal scaling $u g$ of $g$ by $u$ lies in the conformal class of $g$.
nodes.title: Conformal scalings lie in the conformal class

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real vector bundle over a manifold $B$, let $n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty, \omega\}$, let $g$ be a $C^n$ Riemannian metric on $E$, and let $u : B \to \mathbb{R}$ be a $C^n$ function with $u(b) > 0$ for every $b \in B$. The conformal scaling of $g$ by $u$ is the $C^n$ Riemannian metric $u g$ on $E$ whose inner product on each fiber $E_b$ is $u(b)$ times the inner product of $g$ on $E_b$.
nodes.title: Conformal scaling of a Riemannian metric

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold modeled on a real normed space, and let $g$ and $g'$ be $C^\infty$ Riemannian metrics on $M$, with inner products $g_x$ and $g'_x$ on the tangent space $T_x M$. Then $g'$ lies in the conformal class of $g$ if and only if there is a $C^\infty$ function $f : M \to \mathbb{R}$ with $g'_x(v, w) = e^{f(x)}\, g_x(v, w)$ for all $x \in M$ and all $v, w \in T_x M$.
nodes.title: Conformal metrics via an exponential factor

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold modeled on a real normed space, and let $g$ and $g'$ be $C^\infty$ Riemannian metrics on $M$. If $g'$ lies in the conformal class of $g$, then $g$ lies in the conformal class of $g'$.
nodes.title: Conformal equivalence is symmetric

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold modeled on a real normed space, and let $g$, $g'$ and $g''$ be $C^\infty$ Riemannian metrics on $M$. If $g'$ lies in the conformal class of $g$ and $g''$ lies in the conformal class of $g'$, then $g''$ lies in the conformal class of $g$.
nodes.title: Conformal equivalence is transitive

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real vector bundle over a manifold $B$, let $m \le n$ be smoothness exponents in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty, \omega\}$, and let $g$ be a $C^n$ Riemannian metric on $E$. For every $b \in B$, the inner product on the fiber $E_b$ of $g$ viewed as a $C^m$ Riemannian metric equals the inner product of $g$ on $E_b$.
nodes.title: Lowering the smoothness keeps the inner product

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real vector bundle over a manifold $B$, let $m \le n$ be smoothness exponents in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty, \omega\}$, and let $g$ be a $C^n$ Riemannian metric on $E$. Then $g$, with the same inner product on every fiber, is a $C^m$ Riemannian metric on $E$.
nodes.title: Lowering the smoothness of a Riemannian metric

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real vector bundle over a manifold $B$, let $n \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty, \omega\}$, and let $g$ and $g'$ be $C^n$ Riemannian metrics on $E$, with inner products $g_b$ and $g'_b$ on the fiber $E_b$. Let $u : B \to \mathbb{R}$ and $b \in B$. If $g'_b(v, w) = u(b)\, g_b(v, w)$ for all $v, w \in E_b$ and $E_b$ contains a nonzero vector, then $u(b) > 0$.
nodes.title: A conformal factor at a point is positive

nodes.summary: Every smooth Riemannian metric $g$ on a smooth manifold $M$ lies in the conformal class of $g$.
nodes.title: A metric lies in its own conformal class
